strict_loaded_host_matching_method: Check transferred archive SHA256 and bytes against trusted CI artifact metadata.
On containerd image store require loaded Id and Descriptor.digest to equal the independently hashed archive OCI manifest62102671; require Descriptor.mediaType to be OCI image manifest.

Require loaded RootFS.Layers to equal every ordered config diff_id above; require complete loaded Config equality to the archive config in the root verifier (this sanitized record omits environment values).
Require exact OCI revision/source labels, User1000:1000 and linux/amd64.
Keep original registry index digest, archive OCI manifest digest and config digest distinct; do not retag or bypass mismatches.
host_observation_provenance: Root independently reported Docker29.9.1 containerd Descriptor/Id62102671 and matching13RootFS layers; root owns final completeConfig comparison and deployment guard.

primary_sources.support: Docker29 defaults to containerd image store on fresh installations; upgraded classic stores may remain classic.
The containerd ImageInspect implementation assigns ID from target.Digest and Descriptor from target, then separately reads the best manifest config and copies config RootFS DiffIDs.
The classic image ID is the digest of configuration JSON; its rootfs references uncompressed layer DiffIDs.

conclusion: The two observed engine IDs identify different verified nodes of the same immutable archive identity graph. The discrepancy is proved by archive bytes, not accepted from a newly observed host ID.
